game.title: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas – The Definitive Edition

roadmap.title: Los Santos
roadmap.description: Play the Los Santos story to The Green Sabre and pick up the early side tasks: food, dancing, BMX, city services and the Assassin mission.

roadmap.title: San Fierro
roadmap.description: Finish the San Fierro story. Go straight to the airport in the Mike Toreno mission, then do driving school and the car exports.

roadmap.title: Las Venturas
roadmap.description: Do the Las Venturas story: sneak into Area 69, gamble at the casino, get six wanted stars and date every girlfriend.

roadmap.title: Endgame and 100%
roadmap.description: Max weapon skills, take every turf, reach 100% completion, finish the story, then start a new game.

achievements.summary: Complete the story mission "Big Smoke".

steps.text: Finish the opening mission, @mechanic{Big Smoke}. Nothing else is available when the game starts.

achievements.description: Buy 8 meals from Cluckin' Bell throughout the game.
achievements.summary: Buy 8 meals during a single visit to a Cluckin' Bell without leaving the restaurant.

guide.context: Buying the 8 meals across separate visits does not reliably count.

steps.text: Go to any @loc{Cluckin' Bell}.
Buy 8 meals in a single visit without leaving the building.

achievements.summary: Complete the final story mission, "End of the Line".

guide.context: The mission opens only after you hold about 20 gang turfs, roughly 35% of all turfs.

steps.text: Capture gang turfs until the mission icon appears at @loc{Sweet's house}.
Optional: complete Firefighter level 12 beforehand. Being fireproof helps in the burning building.
Take a SWAT truck to @npc{Big Smoke}'s compound and fight through its four floors to Big Smoke.
Fight back down through the burning building, then follow @npc{Tenpenny} until the mission ends.

achievements.description: Score at least 30 points in the basketball mini-game.
achievements.summary: Score at least 30 points in one basketball Challenge Mode game.

steps.text: Go to a full basketball court and pick up a ball. The small court at @loc{Sweet's house} has no Challenge Mode.
Press the prompt to start Challenge Mode.
Hold the shoot button and let go at the top of CJ's jump. Each basket gives 1-2 points and adds 10 seconds.
Keep scoring until you have 30 points.

achievements.summary: Export every car on the three vehicle export lists, 10 cars per list.

guide.context: Exports open after the mission @mechanic{Customs Fast Track}. Deliver the cars to the export crane at the @loc{Easter Basin} docks in San Fierro. Undamaged cars pay more, and parked cars can be locked or alarmed.

achievements.summary: Raise CJ's Fat stat to its maximum.

guide.context: Fat shows in the stats menu. Buying too many meals in one visit makes CJ vomit, which loses the weight and blocks food for about 12 hours.

steps.text: Open the stats menu and note the Fat value.
At a @loc{Cluckin' Bell}, Burger Shot or Well Stacked Pizza, buy the largest meal 8 times in a row.
Wait at least 6 in-game hours, then repeat. Waiting up to 24 hours is safer.
Repeat 3 to 4 times until Fat is at maximum.

achievements.summary: Buy any safehouse.

steps.text: Buy any safehouse shown as a green house icon on the map. The Los Santos houses in @loc{Willowfield}, @loc{El Corona}, @loc{Jefferson} and @loc{Verona Beach} cost $10,000.

achievements.description: Use a Pay 'n' Spray with wanted level.
achievements.summary: Drive into a Pay 'n' Spray while you have a wanted level.

steps.text: Get a wanted level, then drive into any Pay 'n' Spray shown by a spray can icon on the map.
The mission @mechanic{Drive-By} requires this, so it often happens during the story.

achievements.summary: Complete the BMX Challenge or the NRG-500 Challenge.

guide.context: Each checkpoint adds 10 seconds to a 10-second start. Some checkpoints sit high in the air.

steps.text: Ride a bike often until your cycling skill is above 20%. About 60% or more makes the high checkpoints easier.
Lose weight if CJ is heavy. Aim for Fat of about 15-20%.
Get on the BMX in the skate park at @loc{Glen Park}, Los Santos, and collect all 19 checkpoints. Bunny hop to reach the high ones.
Instead, mount the NRG-500 on the upper level of the @loc{Easter Basin} dock yard in San Fierro and collect all 18 checkpoints. Launch off the half-pipe to reach the airborne ones.

achievements.description: Find Mike Toreno during his mission without visiting the places his hints name.
achievements.summary: During the mission "Mike Toreno", drive straight to Easter Bay Airport without visiting the places his hints name.

steps.text: Make a separate save before starting the mission.
Start the mission @mechanic{Mike Toreno}, the second mission from @npc{Jizzy B} in San Fierro.
Ignore Toreno's phone hints, including the Doherty construction site and the Easter Basin docks.
Drive straight to @loc{Easter Bay Airport} and enter the runway.

achievements.summary: Complete the story mission "Saint Mark's Bistro".

steps.text: Take the last Mafia mission, @mechanic{Saint Mark's Bistro}, at @loc{Caligula's Casino} in Las Venturas.
Fly a plane from Las Venturas Airport to Liberty City.
Kill the mafiosi at the bistro and @npc{Marco Forelli}.

achievements.summary: Reach the maximum skill level with every weapon that has a weapon skill.

guide.context: Ten weapons count: AK-47, M4, Combat Shotgun, Shotgun, Sawn-off Shotgun, SMG, Desert Eagle, Pistol, Silenced Pistol, and the Tec-9 or Micro SMG, which share one skill. The last weapons open for purchase after the mission @mechanic{You've Had Your Chips}.

steps.text: Buy each weapon and plenty of ammo at an Ammu-Nation. Plan about 350 rounds for pistols, 1,500 for SMGs, 2,500 for the AK-47 and M4, and 250 for shotguns.
Park any car in one of your garages and shoot it with a weapon you still need to train.
When the car catches fire, step back and let the garage door close. This repairs the car.
Do not let the car explode, or the police will interrupt you.
Repeat for each weapon until all are at maximum.

achievements.summary: Complete every test in one of the four vehicle schools with at least a bronze medal.

guide.context: Driving, Boat and Bike schools open after the mission @mechanic{Deconstruction}. Playing through @mechanic{Learning to Fly} in the story finishes Pilot School, so this usually unlocks on its own.

steps.text: Pick one school: Driving School in Doherty (12 tests), Boat School (5 tests), Pilot School (10 tests) or Bike School (6 tests).
Earn bronze or better on each test in that school.

achievements.summary: Drown CJ in deep water.

steps.text: Save first. Dying costs your weapons unless you are dating @npc{Katie Zhan}.
Swim into deep water and dive.
Stay under until the oxygen runs out and CJ dies.

achievements.displayName: They Can’t Stop All of Us
achievements.description: Sneak into the underground base of Area 69 without setting off the alarm.
achievements.summary: In "Black Project", get into the Area 69 underground base before the surface alarm goes off.

guide.context: Spotlights are what detect you. The alarm only counts once the base announces a lockdown.

steps.text: Make a separate save before the mission.
Buy sniper rifle ammo before you start.
From the entrance, snipe the guards and tower lookouts. Stay near the fence and use headshots from the silenced pistol where needed.
Shoot out at most 2 spotlights. A third one raises the alarm.
Reach the control room on the east side, open the bunker, and go through the doors in the middle. The alarm sounds inside, which is fine.
Finish the mission. The achievement unlocks at the end.
If the alarm goes off outside, let the guards kill you and retry from the checkpoint.

achievements.summary: End a dance routine with an overall Perfect rating.

steps.text: Go to a nightclub dance floor: Alhambra in Idlewood (Los Santos), Gaydar Station (San Fierro) or the club in Las Venturas.
Press the arrow buttons as each arrow crosses the middle.
Finish with the rating bar at Perfect. Missed notes are fine.

achievements.summary: Complete 12 levels of the Vigilante side mission.

guide.context: All 12 levels must be done in one run. Each level adds one criminal.

steps.text: Get into a police vehicle. A police bike works early; the Rhino from Area 69 or a Hunter makes it easy.
Press the prompt to start Vigilante.
Kill the criminals. On a bike, use an SMG with 2,000 or more rounds. Use a Pay 'n' Spray or a police bribe when your wanted level gets high.
Continue through level 12.

achievements.summary: Complete 12 levels of the Paramedic side mission.

guide.context: All 12 levels must be done in one run. Crashing the ambulance or leaving it fails the level.

steps.text: Get into an @item{Ambulance} and press the prompt to start Paramedic.
Pick up patients and bring them to the hospital. Drive carefully and brake for corners, because the ambulance flips easily and carries 3 patients.
@loc{Angel Pine} is the easiest place, because its patients are close together. You start there after The Green Sabre.
Continue through level 12.

achievements.summary: Complete 12 levels of the Firefighter side mission.

guide.context: All 12 levels must be done in one run.

steps.text: Get into a @item{Fire Truck} from a fire station, or start a fire with a molotov cocktail to call one.
Press the prompt to start Firefighter.
Put out every burning car and every burning passenger who runs out.
Do not ram burning cars or run over burning passengers.
Continue through level 12.

achievements.summary: Complete 50 fares in total as a taxi driver.

steps.text: Get into a @item{Taxi} or @item{Cabbie} and press the prompt to start Taxi mode.
Pick up fares and drop them at their destinations.
Reach 50 fares. They do not need to be in one sitting.

achievements.description: Win at least $1,000 in a single spin of the Wheel of Fortune.
achievements.summary: Win $1,000 or more from one spin of the Wheel of Fortune.

guide.context: With no gambling skill, the $100 maximum bet is enough.

steps.text: Find the Wheel of Fortune at the back left of the @loc{Four Dragons Casino} in Las Venturas.
Save the game.
Bet the $100 maximum on the $10 space and spin.
If you lose, reload your save and repeat until you win.
With higher gambling skill, you can instead bet $1,000 on the $1 space of the $1,000 table.

achievements.summary: Complete the story mission "Yay Ka-Boom-Boom".

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{Yay Ka-Boom-Boom}, the last San Fierro story mission. It unlocks Las Venturas.

achievements.displayName: All Dressed Up for San Fierro
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission "The Green Sabre".

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{The Green Sabre}, the last Los Santos story mission. It unlocks San Fierro.

achievements.description: Go on at least one date with every potential girlfriend.
achievements.summary: Go on a date with each of CJ's six possible girlfriends.

guide.context: Only starting the date counts, not how it ends. Start a date from the girl's heart icon on the map. Collecting all 50 oysters removes the appearance requirements.

collectibles.name: Michelle Cannes
collectibles.location: Driving school in Doherty, San Fierro

collectibles.name: Barbara Schternwart
collectibles.location: By the El Quebrados police station
collectibles.method: Needs high fat. Available at night from 12 am to 6 am.

achievements.description: Win a race in Inside Track Betting.
achievements.summary: Win a horse race bet at an Inside Track Betting machine.

steps.text: Go to an Inside Track Betting shop: under the bridge in Downtown Los Santos, or in Montgomery, Red County.
Save the game, then use the horse racing machine and bet on any horse.
If your horse loses, reload and bet again until it wins.

achievements.description: Put all your money or the maximum bet on red or black and win.
achievements.summary: Win a roulette bet of all your money, or the table maximum, on red or black.

steps.text: Save the game and go to any roulette table, for example at the @loc{Four Dragons Casino}. The lowest table caps bets at $100.
Bet the table maximum, or all your money, on red or black.
If you lose, reload and repeat until you win.

achievements.description: Stealth kill all enemies in the mission "Madd Dogg's Rhymes".
achievements.summary: During the mission "Madd Dogg's Rhymes", kill every guard in the mansion without being detected.

guide.context: No guard may spot you. Silenced pistol headshots count as stealth kills, but body shots do not.

steps.text: Make a separate save before the mission.
Enter the mansion with only the knife. Crouch behind each guard and attack to cut their throat.
Take the rhyme book. The first guard you kill afterwards drops a silenced pistol, so kill that guard with the knife.
Use the silenced pistol on the remaining guards. Aim only for headshots.
Leave the mansion. The achievement unlocks as you exit.
If a guard spots you, let them kill you and retry from the checkpoint at the mansion entrance. If the achievement does not unlock, replay the mission.

achievements.summary: Reach maximum respect.

guide.context: Respect rises with story missions and gang turfs. It normally fills up while you capture turfs.

steps.text: Complete story missions.
Capture gang turfs until the Respect stat is full in the stats menu.

achievements.description: Go 24 in-game hours without breaking the law, being wanted or harming anyone.
achievements.summary: Go 24 in-game hours without committing a crime, being wanted or harming anyone.

guide.context: Stealing cars, getting a wanted level or hurting anyone resets the timer.

steps.text: Stay out of trouble: no crimes, no wanted level and no hurting anyone.
Let 24 in-game hours pass. That is about 24 real minutes, so waiting or a gold-level driving school run works.

achievements.summary: Reach a six-star wanted level.

guide.context: Do the Las Venturas mission @mechanic{Fender Ketchup} before the Area 69 run. The sixth star may not appear before it.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{Fender Ketchup}.
Break into @loc{Area 69}, which lies west of Las Venturas. You get 5 stars immediately.
Take the Rhino tank and destroy the police and soldiers chasing you until the sixth star appears.

achievements.summary: Reach maximum sex appeal.

guide.context: Clothes, tattoos and haircut give up to 50%. The car you drive gives the other 50%.

steps.text: Buy the fanciest clothes and the most expensive haircut you can.
At a tattoo parlor, buy tattoos, then switch one body part's tattoo back and forth. Each new tattoo adds 1% until your base reaches 50%.
Get into an undamaged sports car such as the Turismo, Cheetah or Infernus for the other 50%.
If it stays below 100%, tattoo the remaining body parts and wait a moment in the car.

achievements.displayName: Ain’t Nothing But a G Thing
achievements.description: Own all gang warfare turfs, properties and have $1,000,000.
achievements.summary: Own every gang turf and every property, and hold $1,000,000.

guide.context: Turfs you hold are lost when you leave Los Santos, so capture them late. Gang Warfare returns after the mission @mechanic{Home Coming}.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{Home Coming} to unlock Gang Warfare again.
On foot, kill 3 members of the rival gang inside a turf to start a gang war, then beat the 3 waves that attack.
If no gang members appear, shoot a gang car or lure them into the turf, then kill them there.
Buy every property: 24 properties and 5 hotel suites, $879,000 in total. All are open after the mission @mechanic{Learning to Fly}.
Have $1,000,000. Exports, race tournaments and 100% completion all pay well.
Date @npc{Katie Zhan} first so you keep your weapons if you die.

achievements.summary: Reach 100% completion on a save file.

guide.context: Your completion percentage is at the bottom of the miscellaneous page of the stats menu.

achievements.description: Start a new game after getting 100% on a save file.
achievements.summary: Start a new game while you have a save file at 100% completion.

steps.text: Reach 100% completion on a save file.
Open the pause menu and begin a new game. Your 100% save can be reloaded afterward.

achievements.summary: Unlock every other Steam achievement for the game.

guide.context: Rockstar Social Club achievements are not needed.

steps.text: Unlock the other 34 Steam achievements.
